subject.title: feat: advertise realtime voice provider voices in talk.catalog

question: Should `RealtimeVoiceProviderPlugin` permanently expose one provider-wide flat `voices` list even though known providers can have model-dependent voice compatibility?
rationale: This is an additive but public Plugin SDK decision, and source inspection cannot determine whether maintainers prefer a deliberately limited v1 contract or a model-scoped catalog before external plugins depend on it.

options.title: Approve the flat v1 seam
options.body: Accept the existing schema and speech-provider precedent, require clients to treat omitted lists as unavailable, and leave model-scoped metadata as a future additive extension.

options.title: Require model-scoped voices
options.body: Replace the flat field with metadata that can express valid voices per model before publishing a new external plugin contract.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Keep the transcription and realtime model projection but defer the voice SDK field until the client and provider contract are designed together.

recommendation.title: Approve the flat v1 seam
recommendation.body: Accept the existing schema and speech-provider precedent, require clients to treat omitted lists as unavailable, and leave model-scoped metadata as a future additive extension.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared realtime provider resolution and bridge ownership history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the SDK direction.
